label: This sample demonstrates the Step component of the form builder. Every Step starts a new page; components placed before the first Step (like this paragraph) form a first "General" page. Use Back / Next or click a step in the indicator above. Next validates the required fields of the current step, and Submit only appears on the last step.
Compute
description: Choose the capacity for the job. Both fields are required: Next is refused until they are filled.

label: What type of instance do you want to use? (instance_type)
description: EC2 instance type to provision. This will be used along with vcpus to calculate the number of nodes to provision
name: instance_type

label: How many Virtual CPUs do you want ? (vcpus)
description: Number of Virtual CPUs (vCPUs) to allocate to the simulation
name: vcpus

label: Job and input
description: Name the job and pick its input.

label: Input file(s) / folder(s) (input_file)
description: Optional for this sample. Click Browse to select one or more input files and/or folders.
placeholder: Click Browse to select your input file(s) or folder(s)
name: input_file

label: Solver
description: A field can be conditional inside a step: "Number of solver threads" only appears when the mode is Advanced.

label: Number of solver threads (solver_threads)
description: Only shown, and only required, when Solver mode is Advanced.
name: solver_threads

label: Optional tuning (enable_tuning)
description: Check this box to add the "Tuning" step. Unchecked, every field of that step is hidden, so the step is skipped.
name: enable_tuning

label: Tuning
description: This step only exists when "Show the Tuning step" is checked on the Solver step.

label: (Example) User code to be executed AFTER the solver command (user_post_exec)
name: user_post_exec

label: Storage and submit
description: Last step: the Submit button is shown here only.

label: How much storage do you want (SSD under /scratch)
name: scratch_size

label: Steps are presentation only: the job script receives the same variables as a single-page form. Fields hidden by a condition reach the script empty.
